content: A real friend is someone who genuinely cares about you, supports you, and is there for you during both good and bad times. They listen to you, offer encouragement, and provide honest feedback. A real friend is loyal, trustworthy, and always has your best interests at heart. They accept you for who you are, flaws and all, and make an effort to maintain the friendship through communication, time, and effort. A real friend is someone you can count on and who enriches your life in meaningful ways.
